page.overview:
Who is Wei Zheng?

In the past, Wei Zheng advised Tang Taizong to hold the imperial examination. When the Dragon King of Jing River went against the orders of Heaven, a messenger from Heaven tasked Wei Zheng with executing him. Tang Taizong ordered Wei Zheng to spare the Dragon King, but he fell asleep during a chess game and ended up killing the Dragon King in his dream.

Taizong began slowly dying for breaking his promise to the Dragon King, so Wei Zheng gave him a letter to carry with him for Cui Jue, a deceased magistrate who had become a judge in the Underworld.

Category:Males Category:Humans Category:Mortals
